newsitem.title: USA: Dow surges more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow surges more than 50 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average surged more than 50 points Friday on surprising news that the number of jobs in the economy shrank in September for the first time since January.
The Dow industrials rose as high at 5,983.17, before trading up 38.76 points at 5,971.61 shortly before midday.

Interest-rate sensitive stocks led the rally, paced by a surge in bonds after a surprisingly weak payrolls report. The benchmark 30-year Treasury bond was up 1-1/4, reducing the yield to 6.76 percent from 6.84 percent at Thursday's close.
